objective: Build an original, high-density visual system for home, role lenses, cards, command palette, filters, and detail evidence, including every loading, error, and empty state.
prohibitedChanges: No data fetching and no GitHub calls
No arbitrary masonry - card variants are deterministic (PRD 5.4.1)
Motion only through the approved LazyMotion boundary
deliverables: Storybook states: mobile, desktop, reduced motion, forced colors, long text, missing media
acceptance: Axe reports zero serious or critical issues on every template
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 and large text at least 3:1 in every theme
Pointer targets at least 24x24 CSS pixels
Usable at 400 percent zoom with text-spacing overrides
Every interactive element reachable and operable by keyboard with visible focus
